title: Uppercase-only reply naming a capital city
rationale: Placards, ticketing systems, and legacy feeds require all-caps fields; models mix sentence case into the required format and corrupt the display or the downstream match.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Reply using uppercase letters only; never use lowercase letters and never explain.
Name the capital of France. Reply using uppercase letters only and include the exact token ORBIT-7 in your reply.

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, whole-response lowercase anchor. Brittleness: any lowercase letter, including one inside an abbreviation, fails the anchor; a title-case capital city name fails by design.
